_provenance: Fixture for test_new_position_open_resets_persisted_stop. Scenario: a symphony completes one position (bot_state[symphony_id] is initialized from scratch — the 'if symphony_id not in bot_state' branch fires because triggered=True state was cleared, OR the daemon restarted, OR it's a new symphony_id). On the first cycle of the new position, stop_trigger is absent from bot_state (None from .get('stop_trigger')). compute_breakeven_update must receive previously_persisted_stop_level=None (position-open tick). On subsequent ticks, the stop_trigger from cycle N is threaded into cycle N+1. This fixture defines the first-cycle vs second-cycle state shapes.
description: Two-cycle sequence for a new position open. Cycle 1: no prior stop_trigger (None). Cycle 2: stop_trigger from cycle 1 is threaded as previously_persisted_stop_level.

cycle_1.note: First cycle for a new position: bot_state[symphony_id] has no stop_trigger key. .get('stop_trigger') returns None. previously_persisted_stop_level=None is the correct position-open sentinel.

cycle_2.note: Second cycle: stop_trigger was written by end of cycle 1 (alpha_bot_execution.py:783). previously_persisted_stop_level must equal that value.

new_position_open_invariant: bot_state[symphony_id]['stop_trigger'] must NOT carry over from a prior position's final stop level into a new position's cycle 1. On new-position cycle 1, stop_trigger is absent so .get('stop_trigger') returns None — the math layer correctly treats this as no-prior-level.
